requirement_basis.r2_observable: Twelve previously unseen writing tasks satisfy length, content, purpose and format
requirement_basis.applied_slice: Honor caller-designated source sentence indices during bounded extractive candidate selection; this does not infer semantic requirements, purpose or quality and does not reduce the twelve-task acceptance population.

implementation.request_contract: Strict JSON requires text and max_sentences (1..8); optional max_chars is 1..100000 Unicode scalars, optional format is bullets or paragraph, and optional required_sentence_indices is an array of at most eight unique nonnegative integer indices. Indices are zero-based over source-order candidates produced by the existing punctuation/line-break splitter. An absent list means none are required.
implementation.selection: Effective required indices are stored sorted ascending and selected before ranked fill. Remaining slots use the existing token-frequency, first-sentence and long-sentence ranking under max_chars. Output is restored to source order; every copied sentence retains exact source/output byte spans.
implementation.invalid_required_index_behavior: Malformed, negative, fractional, null, duplicate or over-eight index lists suspend with TEXT_SUMMARY_SCHEMA; an index outside generated candidates suspends with TEXT_SUMMARY_REQUIRED_INDEX. Each stop creates no artifact.
implementation.required_budget_behavior: When required sentence count exceeds max_sentences the route suspends with TEXT_SUMMARY_REQUIRED_LIMIT; when required sentence characters exceed max_chars it suspends with TEXT_SUMMARY_REQUIRED_CHAR_LIMIT. Each stop creates no artifact and no sentence is truncated.
artifact_fields: selected/omitted/length-limited sentence indices and selection ranks
selected character count and effective format
exact source and output byte spans
source JSON string token and source/output hashes
implementation.known_gap: Required indices preserve caller-chosen source sentences but do not judge semantic importance, truth, relevance or completeness. Natural-language constraints, purpose, meaning, conditions, negation, quality and the complete twelve-task B08 observable remain unverified.
